title: Dream private Closure at the explicit bound platform boundary

x-authority.old_pending_tuples: Changed canonical projections invalidate every old pending hash/binding. No silent relabel or fallback spelling.
x-authority.precedence: 66007 overrides conflicting65962 and older ICD pseudocode. This artifact is the single producer-owned C schema/vector authority; source owners must use its checked signed bytes.
x-authority.scope: Closure projection only. No source authentication, native correctness, component qualification, runtime approval, lesson or publication authority follows from codec acceptance.

x-budgets.accounting: Count images+statics as nodes. Count every raw load occurrence plus every LinkMap.statics selection occurrence as an edge; never deduplicate before counting. Charge descriptor+basis+source-lock+raw-result+qualification envelope together; receipt separately. A shared logical basis is counted once in aggregate, but every physical retained copy consumes existing working-storage credits. Reserve actual bytes/copies and bounded result allowance before growth; no clipped proof or uncharged catalogue.
x-budgets.retained_runtime_law: Unchanged1ms ordinary/controller/cleanup/grants, native2msCPU/25mswall/3msinclusive,9x fresh debt,256 attempts, one group/two processes/one runnable thread,30s/four jobs, existing heap/control/foreground/reap/bootstrap gates. Codec checks grant no work exemption.

x-canonical-grammar.depth: Root value has depth0; each object key, object value or array element adds1, including scalar leaves. Maximum10. Apply the existing bounded canonical producer/parser rule before accepting prepared bytes; container-only counting is not this rule.
x-canonical-grammar.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM or trailing LF; valid Unicode scalars only; reject NUL in every key/value string; no Unicode/path/case normalization.
x-canonical-grammar.equality: Parse once, reject invalid syntax, then canonical re-encoding must equal the original bytes exactly. SHA256 covers those exact bytes; projections hash their own canonical bytes alone.
x-canonical-grammar.integers: Shortest decimal integer spelling only; no -0, leading zeros, exponent, fraction, nonfinite value or Boolean-as-integer. Schema numeric bounds are inclusive and parsed with checked full-width integers.
x-canonical-grammar.objects: All field names are the exact ASCII schema names. Reject duplicate/unknown keys before constructing a map. Recursively sort keys by unsigned ASCII bytes; arrays retain their declared order and multiplicity.
x-canonical-grammar.strings: Literal UTF-8 except quote/backslash escaping and standard short control escapes \b,\t,\n,\f,\r; remaining controls use lowercase \u00xx. Do not escape slash or non-ASCII characters. UTF-8 byte bounds supplement JSON Schema codepoint bounds.

x-constraints.rule: Build.platform and Closure.platform equal in every field. Canonical arch is aarch64; only raw Darwin arm64 or aarch64 is admitted. Capture/compare exact release, OS build and nonzero shared-cache UUID; premise is exactly trusted_platform_boundary/1.

IDs are globally unique across images/statics; candidate image/archive Ref.file paths are globally unique. Repeated references to one shared output map must agree on the complete Ref; any repeated offline Ref.path must agree on length/hash. images order is git,gpg, then other image IDs sorted by UTF-8 bytes. Exactly those two root IDs are binary, have source git/gnupg and file paths bin/git/bin/gpg, null install_name and thin ARM64 subtype0. All other images are dylibs with exact captured nonempty LC_ID_DYLIB and exact source/file/Macho bindings.

Macho.loads is every raw LC_LOAD_DYLIB/LC_LOAD_WEAK_DYLIB/LC_REEXPORT_DYLIB/LC_LOAD_UPWARD_DYLIB/LC_LAZY_LOAD_DYLIB, mapped to load/weak/reexport/upward/lazy in original load-command order WITH multiplicity. Macho.rpaths preserves every LC_RPATH in original order with multiplicity. File/UUID/CPU/subtype/rpath/load facts equal the immutable captured candidate image; missing/reordered/inserted records fail that binding, not a blanket duplicate ban.

Every candidate target names a known dylib ID and resolves uniquely to that Image.file inside the admitted exact prefix. Supported names: exact absolute prefix+Ref.path; @loader_path/suffix relative to the loading image directory; @executable_path/suffix relative to each owning root executable directory. Macro suffixes are resolved lexically only, without IO/search, and must remain inside prefix; held no-follow file/directory pins must independently exclude symlink effects. Reject empty/ambiguous resolutions, plain relative names, all @rpath names and other @ macros. Raw strings remain unchanged in metadata. Shared images must resolve to the same target for every reachable owning tool.

cache target has ONLY kind:cache. Its exact absolute normalized name must be in the bound dyld shared cache, verified offline by builder/Root and covered by source review. No @ name, candidate-prefix path, foreign/noncache image or hidden platform catalogue is accepted. Direct git/gpg load whose final component is libobjc-env.dylib is Unsupported for either target kind. Platform-internal nodes/UUIDs/loads/edges are not prepared metadata; their behaviour is the explicit trusted OS/cache premise.

Every image is reachable from git or gpg through candidate targets. Every static archive is used by a reachable output LinkMap. Candidate cycles are allowed only with finite complete captured nodes; unknown/duplicate/unreachable nodes fail. Counts are applied before accepting all links.

LinkMap rows cover EXACTLY every reachable (tool,output-image) pair, including both tools for a shared image. No duplicate pair. Sort by tool order git,gpg, within each tool root output first then other output IDs by UTF-8 bytes. output_sha256 equals that image's file SHA256; immutable file Ref is the actual output link map. A shared output's map Ref, output hash and ordered statics rows agree across tool rows. Source/file/map/member context is actual retained provenance, never self-certified from these scalar claims.

statics is byte-lexically sorted by archive ID, unique and reachable; source/file/full real member_index Ref bind the actual archive. Each LinkMap has one StaticUse per participating archive, ordered by first selected occurrence in that exact link map. Members of each archive are grouped in their link-map occurrence order, including repeats; member_count counts occurrences and is >=1. Empty selection is represented by no StaticUse, never a zero-count entry or unused Archive. StaticUse hashes/counts must equal offline recomputation from the immutable map and actual archive index.

For each selected member, take its exact raw linker-table member-name bytes; nonempty length1..4096, no NUL/CR/LF. Never trim, Unicode-normalize, basename-convert, sort or deduplicate. Reject ambiguous/unparseable map/index representations. members_sha256=SHA256(concat(u32BE(byte_length(name)) || name)) in occurrence order; NO domain, count, terminator or delimiter bytes. Repeated names repeat the complete frame. Parser checks each4-byte big-endian length, complete extent and total count; no trailing bytes. Reconcile every selected name with the actual retained archive index.

Prepared bytes include complete bounded Closure facts, Ref path/len/hash scalars, ordered static counts/hashes, exact candidate file identities through existing Build/outer pins, and Platform6 tuple. Large raw maps/archives/member indexes/source/config/platform inspection evidence stays immutable offline provenance, prevalidated by builder/Root. Q2 does not read those Ref payloads or an external catalogue at runtime; refs are not extra uncharged authority. Current candidate-image/config reads retain existing charged paced/no-follow bounds.

Before helper birth and after actual settlement, compare exact candidate pins, Build/Closure Platform tuple and current incarnation/original effect. An observed mismatch is sticky even if values return A→B→A; do not restore an old epoch, erase debt, create replacement work or accept partial publication. Checkpoint equality does not prove absence of unobserved transient changes or arbitrary child mapping; those remain explicit platform/source trust premises. Only the canonical atomic complete publication state permits consumption; codec success cannot approve runtime use.

Syntax/shape controls and immutable-context controls are distinct. A real repeated load/member sequence is valid; an insertion/drop/reorder/mode/UUID/source/file/map/member mutation against unchanged captured context fails equality/projection/source binding. Recomputed attacker hashes do not create independent source authenticity or Root admission. Synthetic vectors exercise the codec only and are never a real Basis/probe/candidate.
